description: This file provides low-level I/O routines using inline assembly for reading from and writing to memory-mapped hardware registers. It includes functions for 8, 16, and 32-bit data in both little-endian and big-endian formats, as well as synchronization primitives.

methods.name: uint8_t in_8(const volatile uint8_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit value from a memory-mapped I/O address with inline assembly.

methods.name: void out_8(volatile uint8_t * addr,uint8_t val)
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit value to a memory-mapped I/O address with inline assembly.

methods.name: uint16_t in_le16(const volatile uint16_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit little-endian value from a memory-mapped I/O address with inline assembly.

methods.name: uint16_t in_be16(const volatile uint16_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit big-endian value from a memory-mapped I/O address with inline assembly.

methods.name: void out_le16(volatile uint16_t * addr,uint16_t val)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit little-endian value to a memory-mapped I/O address with inline assembly.

methods.name: void out_be16(volatile uint16_t * addr,uint16_t val)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit big-endian value to a memory-mapped I/O address with inline assembly.

methods.name: uint32_t in_le32(const volatile uint32_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit little-endian value from a memory-mapped I/O address with inline assembly.

methods.name: uint32_t in_be32(const volatile uint32_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit big-endian value from a memory-mapped I/O address with inline assembly.

methods.name: void out_le32(volatile uint32_t * addr,uint32_t val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit little-endian value to a memory-mapped I/O address with inline assembly.

methods.name: void out_be32(volatile uint32_t * addr,uint32_t val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit big-endian value to a memory-mapped I/O address with inline assembly.

methods.name: void sync(void)
methods.description: Inserts a processor synchronization barrier using inline assembly.

methods.name: void eieio(void)
methods.description: Executes the 'eieio' instruction to ensure instruction and data ordering on PowerPC architectures.

methods.name: void barrier(void)
methods.description: Provides a compiler and CPU memory barrier placeholder.
